title: TICT travel inspiration to product reveal
hypothesis: Showing an aspirational trip before revealing the same trip inside TICT makes the product benefit immediately understandable.

storyboard.intent: A concrete aspirational travel moment with a strong visual hook.
Show fragmented planning or decision overload.
Transition from the travel scene into the matching trip inside the real TICT UI.
Demonstrate AI planning, editing, or navigator behavior with readable UI.
